nodes.title: H3MD outputs / 输出说明
widgets_values:
H3MD Loop Sampler - outputs / 输出说明

输出说明：只有 'long video' → H3MD Save Video Interp 是按有限显存/内存设计的（从磁盘缓存一段一段流式处理）。'latent'（拼好的音视频 latent）和 'audio'（拼好的音频）也可以接到别的节点做放大或自定义处理，例如 Separate AV Latent → Hyper-VAE 或 VAE 解码器 → VHS Video Combine。'images' 只是 64x64 占位图（merge_images 已删除）：要拿到画面帧，请在外部解码 'latent'。警告：大/长视频走 latent / 解码图片 / audio 这些路径不保证显存/内存不爆——在外部解码整段 latent 会把整段视频放进内存。

RIFE 插帧模型 flownet.pkl 不在下载弹窗里（弹窗只支持 models/ 下已注册的文件夹，而且不允许 .pkl），需要手动下载：节点包 ComfyUI-VFI（https://github.com/GACLove/ComfyUI-VFI）；模型来源 https://huggingface.co/hzwer/RIFE/resolve/main/RIFEv4.26_0921.zip ，解压后把其中的 flownet.pkl 放到 custom_nodes/ComfyUI-VFI/rife/train_log/flownet.pkl（相对 ComfyUI 根目录）。（ComfyUI-VFI 第一次运行时通常也会自动下载这个 zip。）

Outputs: only 'long video' -> H3MD Save Video Interp is designed to stay within bounded VRAM/RAM (it streams chunk by chunk from the disk cache). 'latent' (the joined audio-video latent) and 'audio' (the joined audio) can also be connected to other nodes for upscaling / custom processing, e.g. Separate AV Latent -> Hyper-VAE or a VAE decoder -> VHS Video Combine. 'images' is only a 64x64 placeholder (merge_images was removed): to get frames, decode 'latent' externally. WARNING: for large / long videos the latent / decoded-image / audio paths do NOT guarantee against VRAM/RAM blowups - decoding the full latent externally holds the whole clip in memory.

RIFE flownet.pkl is NOT in the missing-models download list (the popup only downloads into registered models/ folders and does not allow .pkl) - download it manually: node pack ComfyUI-VFI (https://github.com/GACLove/ComfyUI-VFI); model source https://huggingface.co/hzwer/RIFE/resolve/main/RIFEv4.26_0921.zip - extract flownet.pkl from it to custom_nodes/ComfyUI-VFI/rife/train_log/flownet.pkl (relative to the ComfyUI root). (ComfyUI-VFI normally also downloads this zip itself on first use.)

widgets_values:
## H3MD 必需模型 / Required models

点文件名即可下载，下载后放到 `ComfyUI/models/` 下标注的文件夹，文件名不要改。  
Click a file name to download it, then put it in the folder shown under `ComfyUI/models/`, keeping the file name.

---

### 作者模型 / Author's models

（待补充 / To be added）

---

### 必需模型 / Required models

**1. 主模型 / Base model** (UNETLoader #4)  
- [minimax_h3_hybrid_fl2va_ref2va_b25-49-int8.safetensors - models/diffusion_models/](https://huggingface.co/smhfacct/Minimax-H3-fl2va-ref2va-hybrid-models/resolve/main/minimax_h3_hybrid_fl2va_ref2va_b25-49-int8.safetensors?download=true)
- 仓库 / Repo: [smhfacct/Minimax-H3-fl2va-ref2va-hybrid-models](https://huggingface.co/smhfacct/Minimax-H3-fl2va-ref2va-hybrid-models)

- [Huihui-Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct-abliterated-int8_convrot.safetensors - models/text_encoders/](https://huggingface.co/ahmed22xa/Huihui-Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct-abliterated-comfy/resolve/main/Huihui-Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct-abliterated-int8_convrot.safetensors?download=true)

- [minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16.safetensors - models/vae/](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/vae/minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16.safetensors?download=true)

- 仓库 / Repo: [Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3)

**5. ClipProj 投影 / ClipProj** (ClipProjApply #108)  
- [mmh3-4b-ClipProj-v3.1-mlp.safetensors - models/clip_projections/](https://huggingface.co/NicoLab28/ClipProj-MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/mmh3-4b-ClipProj-v3.1-mlp.safetensors?download=true)
- 仓库 / Repo: [NicoLab28/ClipProj-MiniMax-H3](https://huggingface.co/NicoLab28/ClipProj-MiniMax-H3)

**6. 潜空间放大 / Latent upscaler** (H3MD Loop Sampler #210)  
- [h3_upscaler_sharpness_2000steps_v0.1_fp32.safetensors - models/latent_upscale_models/](https://huggingface.co/Alissonerdx/Minimax-H3-ComfyUI/resolve/main/latent_upscaler/h3_upscaler_sharpness_2000steps_v0.1_fp32.safetensors?download=true)
- 仓库 / Repo: [Alissonerdx/Minimax-H3-ComfyUI](https://huggingface.co/Alissonerdx/Minimax-H3-ComfyUI)

**7. 低清加速 LoRA / Speed LoRA, low-res** (#106, #118)  
- [minimax_h3_DMAD_4step_full_lora_avg_rank_39_bf16.safetensors - models/loras/](https://huggingface.co/Kijai/MiniMax-H3-experimental/resolve/main/loras/minimax_h3_DMAD_4step_full_lora_avg_rank_39_bf16.safetensors?download=true)
- 仓库 / Repo: [Kijai/MiniMax-H3-experimental](https://huggingface.co/Kijai/MiniMax-H3-experimental)

**8. FL2V 加速 LoRA / Speed LoRA, FL2V** (#5)

- 仓库 / Repo: [lightx2v/Minimax-h3-Turbo](https://huggingface.co/lightx2v/Minimax-h3-Turbo)

- `flownet.pkl`：ComfyUI-VFI 首次使用时自动下载，或按 README 的 RIFE 一节手动下载。  
  ComfyUI-VFI downloads it on first use; manual steps are in the README RIFE section.
